domain: A dispute among orchestras over whether musicians should be permitted to retune their instruments mid-performance, and what it reveals about competing theories of what a musical work actually is
topic: A dispute among orchestras over whether musicians should be permitted to retune their instruments mid-performance, and what it reveals about competing theories of what a musical work actually is

source.title: Who do you think you are? There are two answers

movement.gist: Stage the concrete dispute: a well-known orchestra's principal oboist began quietly re-sounding the tuning note (the 'A') between movements, drawing rebuke from colleagues who called it disruptive vanity, and support from others who called it responsiveness to a warming hall.

Lay out the evidence of how widespread and old this fault-line is: cite the variance in how orchestras handle mid-concert retuning across countries and eras, and the surprising lack of any written rule governing it.

Escalate stakes: show that the disagreement has migrated from etiquette committees into recording contracts and critical reviews, with critics on each side treating the other's practice as a betrayal of the composer or of the audience, not merely a preference.

Name the underlying anatomy: this is not a dispute about pitch at all but a proxy battle between two incompatible ontologies of the musical work — the work as fixed text versus the work as unrepeatable occasion — each retuning act silently asserting one of these.

Explain why the two sides cannot argue this directly: the ontological commitment is pre-theoretical and constitutive of how each musician was trained to relate to a score, so any direct debate about 'what music is' collapses into assertion and counter-assertion, leaving technical dispute as the only available battlefield.

primary.axis: a musical work as a fixed object to be preserved vs. a musical work as an event that only exists in its live realization
poles: the score is the work, and performance is mere transmission of it
the performance is the work, and the score is only a recipe consumed in the making

secondary.axis: whether the retuning dispute is a practical craft question or a metaphysical one in disguise
poles: it's a matter of intonation technique and orchestral discipline
it's a proxy for what kind of thing music is

tension_system.interaction: the secondary tension is the trapdoor beneath the primary: readers keep expecting the essay to settle the tuning etiquette, but the argument reveals that no settlement of etiquette was ever possible without first settling the metaphysics, and once that is settled the etiquette question becomes trivial

family_realization.note: Flawlessly executes proxy-war structure. Paragraph 1 establishes surface dispute (four-second gesture). Paragraph 4 unmasked: 'not disagreeing about pitch' but 'asserting two incompatible accounts.' Passage explains why proxy forms: 'direct debate collapses into assertion answered by assertion.' Surface never adjudicated; deeper claim resolved instead.

ending_behavior.note: Recipe/meal analogy widens aperture perfectly. Local question (may retuning stay audible?) opens onto: what is a work? Closing stance explicit: 'the record does favor one side' yet 'the etiquette will never say so.' Resolution qualified—verdict exists philosophically but remains institutionally dormant.

voice_consistency.note: Forensic skeptic voice sustained throughout. Courtroom precision: 'The record shows,' 'no governing body,' 'one can consult.' Withholds sympathy: 'easy to read,' 'That reading mistakes.' Prose hides ordered reasoning inside subordinate clauses: 'since every reason...already assumes.'

distractor_efficiency.note: Q1(B): stance_misread trap—anecdote vs. thesis reframing. Q2(A): level_confusion trap—passage explicitly rejects turf-war reading. Q3(C): TR3 stance_misread—confuses anticipated pluralism with author position. Q4(B): causal_inversion trap—reverses constitutive commitment logic. Q5(D): analogy inversion trap—misreads recipe subordination.

explanation_quality.note: Every elimination cites passage location and mechanism. 'Q1(C) premature_closure—stops at circularity point in paragraph 5 and misses that the passage does, in the end, favor one side.' Mechanistic not formulaic. Avoids 'not mentioned'; targets logical confusions readers actually make.

answers.reasoning: Passage argues retuning dispute is proxy for ontology of musical work, favors occasion account.
Text says stakes outgrew etiquette committee, critics take sides as betrayal, contracts specify treatment.
Sentence sets up balanced expectation then passage says 'that expectation should be resisted.'
Text explicitly states reasons already assume the position they mean to prove.
Recipe/meal caveat crystallizes verdict favoring occasion account, with proviso; rival C considered but text favors one side.
Passage settles ontology favoring occasion account but etiquette practice remains unresolved/unnamed.
